messages:
Maya: quick accessibility check on the dashboard filters — did a VoiceOver + keyboard pass and flagged a few things :eyes:

Alex: which filters/page? can you drop steps to repro?

Maya: Console -> Project Insights -> Filters bar (top-left). Steps:
1) Tab to the filter group
2) Open the date range dropdown with Space/Enter
3) Try to use arrow keys to move between presets

Jules: thx. high-level findings?

Maya: summary: focus styles are almost invisible, some interactive icons are not keyboard focusable, combobox aria is missing role/label, contrast problems on placeholder text, VoiceOver reads some items twice.

Olivia: any screenshots or quick clips?

Maya: attached a short screencap in thread (uploaded). Also ran axe locally — here's the failing rules I saw:
```
1) color-contrast (button background #f6f7f9 vs text #8a8f98) -> 2.1:1 (needs 4.5:1)
2) focus-visible (outline: none on .filter-pill)
3) aria-allowed-attr (combobox missing aria-expanded)
4) tabindex (icon-button missing tabindex)
```

Sam: Oof, the contrast is bad on the pills. Those were tightened for the polished look but UX loses here.

Jules: Can you paste the CSS for the pill? maybe we can tweak without changing design too much.

Maya: current CSS snippet I saw:
```
.filter-pill { background: #f6f7f9; color: #8a8f98; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; }
.filter-pill:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: none; }
```

Maya: suggestions I recommend:
- increase text color to at least #2f3338 (gives ~7:1 on that bg) OR darken bg to meet 4.5:1
- restore a visible focus style: `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(66,153,225,0.4)` or `outline: 3px solid #22559a` for keyboard users
- make icon-only buttons `button` elements with `aria-label` (e.g., `aria-label=\"Clear date filter\"`)
- combobox should use `role=\"combobox\"` + `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` for the listbox
- add `aria-live=\"polite\"` on the results count region when filters change

Alex: sounds good. quick ask: for the focus ring — do we want system-default or a brand ring? can we reuse the existing global token `--focus-ring`?

Jules: reuse token if available. accessibility wins if consistent. but ensure contrast for the ring against both light/dark backgrounds.

Olivia: I can add keyboard e2e tests once fixes are in. Which interactions need tests?

Maya: at minimum:
- Tab sequence: Filter group -> first pill -> open dropdown -> arrow navigation in dropdown -> Esc closes
- Icon buttons reachable via Tab and activated via Space/Enter
- Live region announces result count after applying filters

Sam: any screen-reader specific gotchas? VoiceOver vs NVDA differences?

Maya: yes — VoiceOver on mac treats `role=listbox` differently and will sometimes read placeholder as first item if not hidden. NVDA can be stricter about `aria-activedescendant`. So prefer explicit `aria-selected` on list items and keep placeholder `aria-hidden=\"true\"` if it's decorative. Also ensure `aria-expanded` toggles correctly on the controlling element.

Jules: good call. can we add a small a11y note in the component docs? e.g., required attributes and keyboard map.

Alex: I'll pick this up — will patch CSS and add aria attributes. ETA: EOD tomorrow?

Maya: thanks! quick patches I'd accept in PR: color change, focus token, make icon buttons real `<button>`s with aria-labels, add aria-live on results. I'll re-run axe and do a VoiceOver pass on mac once PR is up. :white_check_mark:

a11y-bot: Reminder — run `npx @axe-core/cli --rules color-contrast,focusable,aria-valid` against the component before merging.

Olivia: I'll add the keyboard tests to the release card after PR link.

Sam: small nit — copy for the date preset `Last 7 days` should not be truncated by pills on narrow screens. Could we allow wrapping or add ellipsis tooltip?

Maya: prefer wrapping for accessibility — tooltips are inaccessible for keyboard-only users unless triggered via focus. Wrap with `white-space: normal` and ensure min-height to keep tappable area >= 44px.

Alex: thanks everyone — will open PR with changes and link here.

Maya: awesome, appreciate the quick turnaround.

Jules: :raised_hands:

(End of thread)
